verdict.rationale: Gusto is expanding into business banking, with a day-one bank account and a Money Dashboard, so a spend-management question about card receipts is a fair one to ask. However, nothing in the evidence mentions company cards, automatic receipt capture, or expense coding. The bank-account, cash-flow, general-ledger and webhook material is adjacent and does not show this capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have receipts automatically captured and coded the moment a card is used, without manual entry
